newsitem.title: USA: Team Rental completes Budget acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Team Rental completes Budget acquisition.

text.p: Team Rental Group Inc said Thursday that it completed its acquisition of Budget Rent a Car Corp on April 29.
The company, which is changing its name to Budget Group Inc, said it raised $495 million in common and preferred stock and note issuances to fund the acquisition and provide working capital.
Additionally, two new vehicle financing facilities with a combined capacity of $1.4 billion were put in place to provide financing for the combined company's rental fleets.

The company said it will use the funding to enhance the Budget brand name, continue expanding its retail vehicles sales operations and improve and expand the performance of its car and truck rental operations.
